entities.summary: Konstantinos "Kostas" Papanikolaou, nicknamed "Air Pap", is a Greek professional basketball player and the team captain for Olympiacos of the Greek Basket League (GBL) and the EuroLeague. Standing at 2.04 m, he plays at the small forward position. He is widely considered among the best defensive players in European basketball.
